en: The image shows an illustration of a woman in traditional folk costume, holding a large wicker basket. The design is vintage, with muted colors typical of historical postcards. There is printed text in Russian and German, with a mention of 'Oeselsche Bauertrachten' and 'Pyha', suggesting a focus on regional folk dress. The publisher's imprint is printed vertically along the left edge.
